faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Morada Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Support Staff for Boys' Hostel posts at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Morada is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Support Staff at OAV Morada?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Support Staff for Boys' Hostel posts at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Morada.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Warden post?
faq.answer: For the Warden post, candidates need to have a B.A. / B.Sc. degree from a recognized university with at least two years of experience in hostel management.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Cook post is Rs. 6,750/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya: https://oav.edu.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is OAVM/554/2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of OAV Morada?
faq.answer: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Morada is located in Morada, Odisha, with the pincode 757020.
